content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the agreement; fees are governed solely by the Fee Schedule.

input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: Direction check: the agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or most-favoured-customer mechanic in either direction. Searches for "most favoured/favorable", "no less favourable", "best price", "other customers" and "discount" return nothing, and the pricing provisions (§ 11 Fees, § 10 Maintenance, § 2 Grant of License, § 17) simply reference the Fee Schedule without any obligation on Sparkling to extend Garman terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers. Section 20 (General Matters) likewise contains no MFN. This meets the preferred position — no MFN obligation burdening the Customer — so no redline is warranted. Note this rule is a direction rule, so absence of any MFN is a good outcome for us; if we later want MFN pricing in our favour we would need to negotiate it into the Fee Schedule.
